svg.title: Choose Git sides explicitly
svg.desc: During a normal merge the other side is the incoming branch. During a merge-backend rebase the current side is upstream plus already replayed commits. Choose other for an incoming merge and current to prefer upstream during a rebase. Validate after either operation.
svg.text: “Other” is a Git merge input. It does not always mean the remote branch.
Select other to favor the incoming document
Select current to favor the upstream document
Override the driver for this rebase operation
The entire selected Markdown document wins.
The entire selected Markdown document wins.
Only the generated summary path uses this driver.
Source-code conflicts retain normal Git behavior.
After Git finishes: validate the final checkout
Matching hashes → import. Mismatched hashes → regenerate locally. Export remains explicit.
Uncommitted and untracked files can block Git before a driver runs. Preserve or resolve them deliberately.
